readiness_probe.$warm_comment: Measured 2026-08-03: compose recreates the web container every run; its Vite answers '/' seconds after start (listen probe green) and then RELOADS for dependency re-optimization, dropping the journeys' module requests (ERR_EMPTY_RESPONSE on /src/pages/Login.jsx, ws handshake failures). /@vite/client must serve a non-empty body on consecutive polls before readiness — proves the transform pipeline is warm and stable, not merely listening. EVA publishes its isolated API on 45109 and UI on 45209; container-internal ports remain 3001 and 5173.

$prereq_comment: Docker Desktop is a runtime prerequisite. The shared EVA runner invokes the repo-owned tools/ensure-docker-for-eva.ps1 helper once, waits for the daemon, and re-probes it before launch; it never treats helper exit alone as proof of recovery. Before inspecting ports, an isolated EVA workspace runs the explicit runner-owned prelaunch cleanup for only the eva-family-stewardship-navigator project. The cleanup file has no checkout or env-file dependency, so a hard-killed prior run cannot block the next one. Docker's protected port holders remain excluded from generic port cleanup. The explicit project name and runner-owned compose override keep EVA containers, volumes, and published ports separate from the owner's family-stewardship-navigator project.

prerequisites.remedy: EVA runs tools/ensure-docker-for-eva.ps1 once and re-probes before blocking; inspect Docker Desktop diagnostics if that bounded recovery fails

journeys.name: App shell loads and identifies Family Stewardship Navigator
journeys.$expected_comment: The app shell's AuthContext.checkUserAuth probes /api/auth/me on mount; an anonymous visitor's probe can only 401. Declared by ENDPOINT (never a blanket '401'), so a 401 anywhere else still reds the journey and no assertion can be suppressed.
journeys.user_impact: If the shell does not load, the family cannot reach login or any stewardship data.

journeys.name: Login page renders with a usable email field

steps.$comment: 30s, not the 10s default: this app's start_command is `docker compose up --build`, so the web container is RECREATED on every run and its Vite dev server is still cold-transforming when the journeys start. Measured 2026-08-03 — the journey passes in isolation and passed on the run right after a warm container, but timed out twice at 10s when run immediately behind app-identifies-itself against a freshly rebuilt container. The email input itself is present and correct (type=email, placeholder you@example.com); this buys boot time, it does not weaken the assertion.

journeys.$assert_comment: Measured 2026-08-03 against the live compose stack: the page reads 'Welcome Back / Sign in to your wealth planning dashboard / Email / Password / Sign In'. It contains the word LOGIN nowhere, so the old "ogin" assertion could never pass — journey drift, not an app defect. The email fill + input_value assertion (which DID pass) is what proves the form is usable; this asserts the page is the sign-in page.
journeys.user_impact: A family member who cannot reach a working login form is locked out of every finance feature.
